3535 ground-truth witnesses: what reflection carries for a struct used as a VS input
====================================================================================

compiler: main-debug (see .cache/compilers/main-debug.json); the binary
self-reports a fork-local commit, cite 13730886e.

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe --version
[exit] 0
    dxcompiler.dll: 1.10(5433-ab540090)(1.9.0.5433) - 1.9.0.5433 (triage, ab5400907)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. The whole ID3D12ShaderReflection surface for the repro
------------------------------------------------------------------------
dxa -dumpreflection walks ID3D12ShaderReflection through DXC's own
D3DReflectionDumper and prints every field of every descriptor it can
reach. This is the answer to 'what can an application actually ask for'.

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E VS -Fo <repo>\.github\skills\dxc-issue-triage\data\issues\3535\out\repro.dxo repro.hlsl
[exit] 0
[check] PASS  repro compiled
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxa.exe -dumpreflection <repo>\.github\skills\dxc-issue-triage\data\issues\3535\out\repro.dxo

------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. The member names dxc prints come from the reflection part
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Three measurements. (a) A default compile prints the cbuffer struct's
HLSL field names, though the DXIL module it prints has no
!dx.typeAnnotations to hold them. (b) Disassembling the container with
-dumpbin prints them too. (c) -Qstrip_reflect removes the reflection
part and they disappear. So the names are rendered from reflection data.

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E VS repro.hlsl
[exit] 0
(a) default compile:
    ;           float3 cbAlpha;                           ; Offset:    0
[check] PASS  (a) cbuffer field name printed
[check] PASS  (a) module carries no !dx.typeAnnotations to print it from

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -dumpbin <repo>\.github\skills\dxc-issue-triage\data\issues\3535\out\repro.dxo
[exit] 0
(b) -dumpbin of the same container:
    ;           float3 cbAlpha;                           ; Offset:    0
[check] PASS  (b) container disassembly prints the field name

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E VS -Qstrip_reflect -Fo <repo>\.github\skills\dxc-issue-triage\data\issues\3535\out\stripped.dxo repro.hlsl
[exit] 0
$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxa.exe -listparts <repo>\.github\skills\dxc-issue-triage\data\issues\3535\out\repro.dxo
[exit] 0

------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. The front end holds the field name and the semantic together
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-fcgl stops before DXIL lowering. Tag 6 is
kDxilFieldAnnotationFieldNameTag and tag 4 is
kDxilFieldAnnotationSemanticStringTag
(include/dxc/DXIL/DxilMetadataHelper.h:247,249), so one annotation
carries both halves of the mapping the reporter is asking for.

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E VS -fcgl repro.hlsl
[exit] 0
    !6 = !{i32 0, %struct.CbStruct undef, !7, %struct.VertexOut undef, !10, %struct.VertexIn undef, !13, %Params undef, !16}
    !8 = !{i32 6, !"cbAlpha", i32 3, i32 0, i32 7, i32 9}
    !14 = !{i32 6, !"mPos", i32 3, i32 0, i32 4, !"POSITION", i32 7, i32 9}
    !15 = !{i32 6, !"mColor", i32 3, i32 16, i32 4, !"COLOR", i32 7, i32 9}
[check] PASS  field name and semantic appear in one annotation before lowering
------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. What survives into reflection metadata after lowering
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-Qkeep_reflect_in_dxil keeps the reflection metadata in the DXIL part so
it can be read directly. The constant-buffer struct is annotated; the
input struct has no annotation at all, and its type is gone.

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E VS -Qkeep_reflect_in_dxil repro.hlsl
[exit] 0
    %struct.CbStruct = type { <3 x float>, <3 x float> }
    !dx.typeAnnotations = !{!7, !13}
    !7 = !{i32 0, %struct.CbStruct undef, !8, %Params undef, !11}
    !9 = !{i32 6, !"cbAlpha", i32 3, i32 0, i32 7, i32 9}
[check] PASS  reflection metadata is present to inspect
[check] PASS  cbuffer struct is annotated with its field names
[check] PASS  input struct has no field-name annotation
[check] PASS  input struct type is not even declared in the module
------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. The names do survive in debug info
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-Zi keeps DWARF-style member metadata. This is not reflection and is not
reachable through ID3D12ShaderReflection, but it does mean the names
still exist in a -Zi build's debug module. It is also why a Compiler
Explorer pane cannot be searched for these identifiers: CE appends
-Zi -Qembed_debug to every DXC pane.

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe -T vs_6_0 -E VS -Zi -Qembed_debug repro.hlsl
[exit] 0
    !32 = !DICompositeType(tag: DW_TAG_structure_type, name: "VertexIn", file: !1, line: 31, size: 192, align: 32, elements: !33)
    !34 = !DIDerivedType(tag: DW_TAG_member, name: "mPos", scope: !32, file: !1, line: 32, baseType: !24, size: 96, align: 32)
    !35 = !DIDerivedType(tag: DW_TAG_member, name: "mColor", scope: !32, file: !1, line: 33, baseType: !24, size: 96, align: 32, offset: 96)
[check] PASS  debug info names the struct members
------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. D3D12_SIGNATURE_PARAMETER_DESC is the whole of what a signature
   element can report, and no call reaches a type from one
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Quoted from the header this build compiles against.

    external/DirectX-Headers/include/directx/d3d12shader.h
    typedef struct _D3D12_SIGNATURE_PARAMETER_DESC
    {
        LPCSTR                      SemanticName;   // Name of the semantic
        UINT                        SemanticIndex;  // Index of the semantic
        UINT                        Register;       // Number of member variables
        D3D_NAME                    SystemValueType;// A predefined system value, or D3D_NAME_UNDEFINED if not applicable
        D3D_REGISTER_COMPONENT_TYPE ComponentType;  // Scalar type (e.g. uint, float, etc.)
        BYTE                        Mask;           // Mask to indicate which components of the register
                                                    // are used (combination of D3D10_COMPONENT_MASK values)
        BYTE                        ReadWriteMask;  // Mask to indicate whether a given component is
                                                    // never written (if this is an output signature) or
                                                    // always read (if this is an input signature).
                                                    // (combination of D3D_MASK_* values)
        UINT                        Stream;         // Stream index
        D3D_MIN_PRECISION           MinPrecision;   // Minimum desired interpolation precision
    } D3D12_SIGNATURE_PARAMETER_DESC;
[check] PASS  SemanticName is the only string in the descriptor

And there is no indirect route either. ID3D12ShaderReflectionType is
the only interface that can name a struct's members
(GetMemberTypeName), and the whole of ID3D12ShaderReflection is:

    STDMETHOD(QueryInterface)(THIS_ _In_ REFIID iid,
    STDMETHOD_(ULONG, AddRef)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(ULONG, Release)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD(GetDesc)(THIS_ _Out_ D3D12_SHADER_DESC *pDesc) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(ID3D12ShaderReflectionConstantBuffer*, GetConstantBufferByIndex)(THIS_ _In_ UINT Index) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(ID3D12ShaderReflectionConstantBuffer*, GetConstantBufferByName)(THIS_ _In_ LPCSTR Name) PURE;
    STDMETHOD(GetResourceBindingDesc)(THIS_ _In_ UINT ResourceIndex,
    STDMETHOD(GetInputParameterDesc)(THIS_ _In_ UINT ParameterIndex,
    STDMETHOD(GetOutputParameterDesc)(THIS_ _In_ UINT ParameterIndex,
    STDMETHOD(GetPatchConstantParameterDesc)(THIS_ _In_ UINT ParameterIndex,
    STDMETHOD_(ID3D12ShaderReflectionVariable*, GetVariableByName)(THIS_ _In_ LPCSTR Name) PURE;
    STDMETHOD(GetResourceBindingDescByName)(THIS_ _In_ LPCSTR Name,
    STDMETHOD_(UINT, GetMovInstructionCount)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(UINT, GetMovcInstructionCount)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(UINT, GetConversionInstructionCount)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(UINT, GetBitwiseInstructionCount)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(D3D_PRIMITIVE, GetGSInputPrimitive)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(BOOL, IsSampleFrequencyShader)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(UINT, GetNumInterfaceSlots)(THIS) PURE;
    STDMETHOD(GetMinFeatureLevel)(THIS_ _Out_ enum D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL* pLevel) PURE;
    STDMETHOD_(UINT, GetThreadGroupSize)(THIS_
    STDMETHOD_(UINT64, GetRequiresFlags)(THIS) PURE;

Only GetConstantBufferByIndex/ByName and GetVariableByName lead to a
type object. Nothing accepts a signature parameter index and returns
one, so GetMemberTypeName cannot be called for an input struct at all.
This is a COM vtable, so it is fixed for every version of the API.
[check] PASS  no method maps a signature parameter to a reflection type
[check] PASS  the only routes to a type object are the two cbuffer accessors and GetVariableByName

Note what this means for the instrument in section 1:
D3DReflectionDumper never calls GetMemberTypeName, so the absence of a
member name from that dump is on its own ambiguous. The dump settles
that no *other* printed descriptor field carries the identifier; this
section is what settles that no reachable call could return it.

all self-checks passed
